[Help, legend, allergy info, consults, alternative antimicrobials and more \(Inpt\)](general-information-inpatient)

# BACTERIAL MENINGITIS WITH S. PNEUMONIAE

Once a diagnosis of acute bacterial meningitis is considered likely,

antimicrobials should be initiated as soon as possible. Two blood cultures

should be drawn. Lumbar puncture (LP) should be performed in nearly all patients

to obtain cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) for establishing diagnosis and determining

infectious organism/susceptibility. Adjust antimicrobial regimen to optimize

therapy and treatment duration based on pathogen once isolated.

Intravenous dexamethasone therapy improves outcomes for meningitis with

Streptococcus pneumoniae and is recommended for empirical treatment of all

community acquired cases that might be associated with S. pneumoniae.

Dexamethasone must be given before (1 to 20 minutes) with antimicrobials.

# If Initiating Therapy, Give:

[Dexamethasone 10 mg IV q6h \($\) for 4 days](psjzid-dexamethasone-10mg-iv-q6h-4d)

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Antimicrobial Treatment

Note: Antimicrobials depend on S. pneumoniae MIC results. In most cases results

will usually be known only after 2 or 3 days of therapy.

# Duration of Therapy

Treat for a total duration of 10-14 days.

# Treatment if Penicillin MIC < or = 0.1 mcg/mL

Preferred:

[Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h \($$\) R](psjizid-penicillin-g-4-million-units-iv-q4h)

< OR >

[Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h \($$\) R](psjizid-ampicillin-2-gm-iv-q4h)

< OR >

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) M](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q12h)

# Treatment if Penicillin MIC > or = 0.1 mcg/mL and Ceftriaxone MIC < or = 0.5

# mcg/mL

Preferred:

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) M](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q12h)

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R](psjizid-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h)

# Treatment if Penicillin MIC > or = 0.1 mcg/mL and Ceftriaxone MIC > 0.5 mcg/mL

Treat as listed below, and obtain another CSF specimen in 24 to 48 hours.

Preferred:

Ceftriaxone MIC < 2 mcg/mL

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) M <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-ceftriax-2gm-q12h-and-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)

Ceftriaxone MIC >/= 2 mcg/mL

[< ADD > Rifampin 600 mg PO q24h to above \($\) DI,O](psjzid-rifampin-600mg-po-q24h)

< OR >

[< ADD > Rifampin 600 mg IV q24h to above \($$$$\) DI,O](psjizid-rifampin-600mg-iv-q24h)

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Moxifloxacin 400mg IV q24h \($$\) R,DI <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-moxifloxacin-400mg-iv-q24h-vanco-iv-q12h)
